The 1/3-power in t1/3 is consistent with the height scale of the KPZ universality: see (2.1). This result shows that the one-point marginal of the KPZ ﬁxed point (for the narrow wedge initial condition) must be distributed as the Tracy-Widom distribution. The Tracy-Widom distribution is the limiting distribution of the largest eigenvalue of random Hermitian matrices such as Gaussian unitary ensemble matrices [86].
